helper.scope: Manufactured fixed15DOF linear implicit-Euler reference; no continuum, nonlinear, camera or physical calibration claim
helper.target_used_for_policy: Posterior predictive covariance only; no realized truth or observations
helper.candidate_pokes: Reset experiment from zero state, one .02N smooth pulse; same duration, peak force and scalar impulse across candidates
helper.update: Exact Gaussian likelihood importance reweighting, not Gaussian posterior approximation
helper.ESS_gate: Raw ESS>=400 AND ESS/number_draws>=.05; report per-chain mass and split-half stability; no ESS establishes calibrated coverage

design.Fisher: Local exact finite-difference observation Jacobian at posterior intrinsic mean; trace((posterior_cov^-1+JtJ/sigma2)^-1) reduction
design.split_blocks: Each of eight original chains split into contiguous halves
design.importance_gate: rawESS>=400 and fraction>=.05; autocorrelation-adjustedESS not established
design.scope: One known manufactured object and repeated observation noise only; no population calibration or nonlinear continuum claim
design.moment_stability: Pre/post mean AND standard deviation; 16MH halves and three independent SMC references
design.acquisition_stability: All16MH half and3SMC target-variance top choices equal pooledMH; maximum score difference<=.1*max(abs(pooledscore))
design.superiority: All numerical gates and upper pairednoiseCI + empirical numerical envelope <0. Envelope=max advantage difference from16MHhalf and3SMC estimates; diagnostic, not rigorous bound
design.actuation_budget: Same net force peak, duration and scalar impulse; mechanical work and per-node force norm need not be equal
